name: Vitre Windows
description: Window motion for Vitre. A minimized window slides into its Dock icon and restoring flies it back out, new windows grow in, closing windows shrink away, a window that is tiled, maximized, restored or pulled out of its tile flows to its new place on a spring, and the Dock icon hops while an app launches. With reduced motion a window that changes size fades in place and the other motions are GNOME's own; with animations off every change is a single cut.
